_comment: Field definitions for the SUPERVISION 'bdd' table/CSV export (site-level data, not tied to a single magnet/housing). Each entry maps a column name to {description, symbol, unit, group}. unit must be a pint-parseable string; use null for dimensionless/time columns. 'group' assigns the field to a display block in the dashboards — 'Refroidissement' matches pupitre-defs.json's own cooling-loop group name so bdd's site-level temperatures can be shown alongside a magnet's own pupitre temperature channels.

teb.description: Site-level input temperature, secondary cooling loop (SUPERVISION)

tsb.description: Site-level output temperature, secondary cooling loop (SUPERVISION)

ted.description: Primary cooling loop temperature at the heat exchanger hot-side inlet, same measurement point as the pupitre Tout (SUPERVISION sensor)

tsd.description: Primary cooling loop temperature at the heat exchanger hot-side outlet, same measurement point as the pupitre Tin = (Tin1 + Tin2)/2 (SUPERVISION sensor)

azote1.description: Pressure of nitrogen bottle 1 (200 bar when full) feeding the pressure reducer (~4 bar, adjustable) that pressurises the low-pressure side (BP) of the cooling loop through reservoir R1, shared by all housings; the reducer switches to bottle 2 automatically (SUPERVISION)

azote2.description: Pressure of nitrogen bottle 2 (200 bar when full), taken over automatically by the pressure reducer when bottle 1 runs low; see azote1 (SUPERVISION)

niv1.description: Level of reservoir R1, which pressurises the low-pressure side (BP) of the cooling loop of all housings; watched as a leak indicator together with the drop of the nitrogen bottle pressures (SUPERVISION)
